name: Bitbucket Pipelines
summary: Bitbucket Pipelines is the CI/CD service inside Atlassian's Bitbucket Cloud. Plans are priced per user: Free for up to 5 users with 50 build minutes, Standard at $3.65 and Premium at $8 a month. Another 1,000 minutes cost $10 a month.

facts.text: The Free plan is free forever for up to 5 users and includes 50 build minutes shared across the workspace.
Another 1,000 build minutes, or 100 GB of Git LFS storage, cost $10 a month.
The pricing page does not state a build minute allowance for Standard or Premium.
Pipelines starts with default Test, Staging and Production environments, and a Deployments dashboard shows history, statuses and logs.

plans.name: Extra build minutes
plans.notes: Sold as a bundle with 100 GB of Git LFS storage

hiddenCosts: Standard and Premium show no stated build minute allowance, so a busy team may buy extra minutes at $10 per 1,000.
The Free plan caps the workspace at 5 users.
